NBA DFS Picks for Saturday, October 31 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Saturday, October 31 · 5 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 31, 8:20 PM ET

Victor Wembanyama (SAS) is the top-projected player on the Saturday, October 31 DraftKings main slate at 55.2 DraftKings points for $10,900. Jalen Johnson (ATL, 51.3, $9,700) and Domantas Sabonis (SAC, 47.4, $9,400) are next.

Cam Spencer (MEM) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 8.24 projected points per $1,000 at $3,700.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 31, 8:20 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
